question.text: There are two balls in an urn. Each ball can be either white or black. If a white ball is put into the urn and there after a ball is drawn at random from the urn, then the probability that it is white is

solution.text:
Total possible event when one ball is taken out $={ }^3 \mathrm{C}_1$ Let $E$ : The event of 1 white ball coming out
No. of ways to 1 white ball coming out $={ }^2 \mathrm{C}_1$
$$
\therefore P(E)=\frac{{ }^2 C_1}{{ }^3 C_1}=\frac{2}{3}
$$
